title: Google Has a Cool $15 Billion Fix to the AI Energy Problem
summary: Google has found an interesting way to combat the sky-high energy costs involved in data centers—build them in an extremely cold country.  The tech giant announced a 13 billion-euro ($15 billion) investment in artificial-intelligence infrastructure in Finland, in a blog post Wednesday.  The company leads the way among its peers, though, committing to long-term spending of $811 billion for technical infrastructure and inventory as well as energy contracts and content licenses, Barron’s recently reported.
